description: This file defines the internal class NatsBatchContainer, which implements the IBatchContainer interface. It encapsulates batch data related to streaming events in the Orleans framework, specifically for NATS streaming provider integration. The class includes properties for stream identification, sequence tokens, events, request contexts, and reply-to options, along with methods to import request context and retrieve events of a specific type.

classes.name: NatsBatchContainer
classes.description: Internal class implementing IBatchContainer, representing a batch of streaming events with associated metadata in Orleans for NATS provider.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context into the current execution context if available.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specified type from the container, pairing each with the sequence token.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the batch container, including stream ID and item count.
